messages.text: Monday, October 12 · Canton, Michigan
Foggy morning yields to warm autumn day

A foggy start to the day will give way to warm, clear conditions. The most notable local development is the announcement of a lawsuit concerning inmate privacy, while researchers highlight climbing stroke rates in younger adults.
Expect fog this morning, clearing to a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F, with a negligible chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:43 AM, sunset at 6:57 PM, with the new moon 2.8% illuminated.
Local and area happenings
Consider attending the Alash performance at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM for a unique blend of Tuvan throat singing and traditional instruments.
Pop's Birthday is today, October 12th.
Lawsuit filed over inmate privacy during childbirth

A lawsuit filed today alleges that Michigan Department of Corrections officers recorded an inmate during labor, delivery, and postpartum care at an Ann Arbor hospital in March 2025. The complaint claims officers violated privacy policies.
Looking ahead to the week
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak on October 21st. A solar eclipse is predicted in 117 days.

Tuesday, October 13 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn drizzle meets orbital science

A day of light drizzle and mild temperatures is here, with a high near 85°F. Today's science news tracks the origins of solar wind switchbacks, while local events offer a range of performances and workshops.
Expect light drizzle today with a high near 85°F and a low around 64°F; there is a 14% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:45 AM, sunset at 6:55 PM, with the moon in a waxing crescent phase, 7.0% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's artistic offerings
For an evening of classical music, the University Symphony Orchestra performs at Hill Auditorium at 8:00 PM. Alternatively, experience Duane Betts & Palmetto Motel at The Ark, also at 8:00 PM.
Tomorrow features the 862 Meeting at 6:30 PM.
Local news updates and community programs

Michigan drivers will see lower fees for catastrophic auto insurance coverage due to recent reforms. The Plymouth Canton Education Park's Peer to Peer Program continues to foster an inclusive environment through collaborative activities.
Looking ahead
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak on October 21st. The first quarter moon phase occurs on October 18th.
